content: SheetJS xlsx npm package still exists but stale: latest 0.18.5 (no functional releases since 2023; not marked deprecated). SheetJS LLC distributes current 0.20.3 from their own CDN (browser tests run 2026-01-12; docs updated Aug 2026). Official install: npm i -S https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz. Pure JS — works in Expo Go. RN pattern: XLSX.write(wb,{type:'base64',bookType:'xlsx'}) then write base64 via expo-file-system/legacy StorageAccessFramework to Downloads. Official RN demo tested with expo-file-system (updated Aug 3 2026).
